args.title: Clarify CSV BOM prefix behaviour
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

Explain that the CsvOptions.bom option prefixes a byte order mark (BOM) to CSV exports by default. This is intended to help spreadsheet apps detect UTF-8 encoding, as noted in the code comments and BOM constant.

label: feature
file: src/export/csv.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The file src/export/csv.ts prefixes a byte order mark (BOM) to CSV exports by default, which is intentional to help spreadsheet applications correctly detect UTF-8 encoding. This behavior is clearly documented in the code comments and the BOM constant.
